summary: Forest land identification criteria challenge; applicability of Forest Conservation Act, 1980 to private forests; standard: dictionary meaning plus recorded forest areas; minimum 5-hectare area, 75% forest species composition, 40% crown density criteria contested; Supreme Court maintains 'forest' includes all areas with vegetation per dictionary meaning regardless of classification; High Court's redefinition of canopy density rejected; Goa private forest identification process reviewed; criteria for private forest identification upheld.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; criteria for identification of forest land upheld; private forest identification process validated.
